svg.title: Tickets, SLA, notifications
svg.desc: Target design documentation. English diagram labels; not implemented or tested on an application. Sources are recorded in metadata.

g.text: 17 distinct use cases • Shared goals, requester acceptance, IT execution, management intervention.
IT staff may submit personal requests; scope/visibility follows each ticket/parent content.
Requester reopens only Resolved, cancels only New; supported employees never replace ticket requester.
Authorized IT on this record only
T self-claims unassigned team tickets; writes depend on assignee/state. Background scheduler deduplicates alerts.
Assignment/transfer, Closed reopen, cancellation, priority changes need authority/reasons; never reset SLA.
Source: UC catalog · Permissions matrix · BR-01–22
Association means participation, not sequence • AI and scheduler are internal
